title: Employment and Labor Law Requirements
description: Synthetic employment-policy checklist used to review Acme Corp's employee handbook.

requirements.title: Updated parental leave policy
requirements.requirement: The employee handbook must describe the updated parental leave entitlement effective in 2024, including eligibility, paid leave duration, caregiver leave, notice requirements, and the HR contact path.
expected_evidence: A section explicitly dated 2024 or later
Caregiver leave or partner leave coverage

requirements.title: Working hours and overtime
requirements.requirement: The handbook must describe normal working hours, approval for overtime, required rest periods, and manager responsibilities for workload monitoring.

requirements.title: Termination and grievance process
requirements.requirement: The handbook must describe termination procedures, grievance channels, and an appeal or review path for employee disputes.

sections.title: Review overview
sections.content: This synthetic standard checks whether Acme Corp's employee handbook is current, especially for leave policies that changed in 2024.

sections.title: Parental leave baseline
sections.content: A compliant handbook must include the updated 2024 parental leave policy. Missing or expired parental leave language is a high-severity gap.
